programme.title: Lon le Linda
programme.desc: Tha Linda NicLeòid a’ còcaireachd cuide ri a caraidean. An-diugh tha Maya agus Anthony cuide ri Linda agus iad a’ fuine aran sòda. Ach mus tòisich iad, feumaidh iad dèanamh cinnteach gu bheil na tha a dhìth orra a-staigh. Mur a bheil, bidh iad a’ dèanamh liosta agus a’ dol dhan bhùth airson a h-uile càil fhaighinn. Bidh Linda agus a caraidean cuideachd a’ faighinn a-mach cò às a tha min-fhlùir a’ tighinn. Tha iad an uairsin a’ tilleadh dhan chidsin airson aran sòda a dhèanamh mus suidh iad sìos aig a’ bhòrd ga ithe! Linda Macleod and friends cook a number of tasty dishes. In this episode, Linda is joined by Maya and Anthony to make soda bread. Before they start, they must make sure they have all the ingredients and, if not, they prepare a list and go shopping. They also find out more about where flour comes from, before returning to the kitchen to bake the bread and sitting down at the table to tuck in.

programme.title: Oscar & Ealasaid
programme.desc: Tha Dòl Eòin agus Dòl Iain a’ cur Maoileas Mòr an greim agus iad den bheachd gur esan am “Mathan Mòr Mosach”. Gu fortanach, tha Oscar agus Ealasaid a’ dol a rannsachadh na stòiridh gus an caraid a shàbhaladh. Boléro is taken prisoner by Jean-Mich and Jean-Lou, who think he is the 'Big Bad Bear'. Fortunately, Ernest and Célestine are going to get to the bottom of this story to save their friend!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha Nìp ag adhbharachadh thuiltean air feadh an eilein nuair a tha e a’ tòiseachadh ri cladhach na chadal. Neep causes watery mischief all over the Island when he starts digging in his sleep.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: 'S toigh le na h-Abadas a bhith cluich falach-fead. Tha am facal ùr cuideachd comasach air rudan a lorg nuair nach urrainn am faicinn. Dè th'ann agus cò an Abadas a b'fheàrr airson am facal a lorg? The Abadas love playing hide-and-seek. The day's word is also able to seek out things that can't be seen. What could it be and which Abada would be the best one to go and look for the word?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royal Next Door
programme.desc: Nuair tha Stella a’ coinneachadh ris an sgoilear iomlaid aice, Orla, chan eil cùisean a' dol cho math 's a bha i an dùil. Tha Orla caran nèonach. Ciamar a gheibh Stella ceangal eatarra gus am faigh iad air adhart le chèile? When Stella meets her exchange student, Orla, things don’t go as well as she’d hoped. Orla is a little strange. How will Stella find some kind of common bond so that they will get on well with each other?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royal Next Door
programme.desc: Nuair tha Ath-achdachadh Rìoghail dol a bhith ann de bhatal eachdraidheil, tha an Rìgh na ghlòraidh ach chan eil Stella idir toilichte. Saoil dè thachras aig an ath-achdachaidh? When a Royal Re-enactment of a historical battle is going to take place, the King is in his element but Stella isn’t so happy. What do you think will happen at the event?

programme.title: Uaine
programme.desc: An do smaoinich thu riamh mu càit am bi sgudal a’ dol? Tha Calum airson na ceist sin a fhreagairt agus anns a’ phrògram seo, tha e a’ tadhal air Ionad Ath-chuartachaidh Polmadie airson faghinn a-mach dè a tha a’ tachairt dhan sgudal a th’ anns na bionaichean uaine ann am baile Ghlaschu. Have you ever thought about where your rubbish goes? Calum wants to find out more and visits Polmadie Recycling Centre to find out what happens to green bin waste from Glasgow City.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Hikari ‘son rìs fhàs, tha Mgr. Yamanaka, fear a th' air a bhith na thuathanach rìs còrr is caogad bliadhna, dha comhairleachadh. Tha a’ chùis a’ còrdadh rithe ’s tha i a co-dhùnadh gum bi i na tuathanach rìs nuair a dh' fhàsas i mòr. When Hikari wants to grow rice, she gets advice from Mr Yamanaka, who’s been a rice farmer for over 50 years. The process is so enjoyable that Hikari decides she wants to be a rice farmer when she grows up.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: Murdina confronts Johan with CCTV evidence of the hotel fire. Sìleas hatches a plan to save the mill, while Seumas make a sacrifice that could leave him with nothing. Still reeling from the aftermath of the ‘Reul na Mara’ fire, Cairistiona makes a big decision. Anns an earrann mu dheireadh dhen t-sreath, tha Murdina a’ dol aghaidh ri aghaidh ri Johan leis an fhianais CCTV a th’ aice dhen teine san taigh-òsta. Tha Sìleas a’ cur roimhpe a’ mhuileann a shàbhaileadh fhad ‘s a tha Seumas a’ dèanamh ìobairt a dh’fhaodadh fhàgail gun chàil idir. Fhathast a’ feuchainn ri faighinn seachad air an teine ann an ‘Reul na Mara’, tha Cairistìona a’ tighinn gu co-dhùnadh mòr. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Tiugainn a Dhannsa
programme.desc: Thànaig crìoch air earrann de dh'eachdraidh chur-seachadan na Gàidhealtachd is nan Eilean nuair a dhùin tallachan -baile ann an iomadh ceàrnaidh. Chaidh tallachan ur an àrda ach is ann ag amas air feumalachdan ginealach ur a bha iad sin. Tha am prògram seo a' toirt beò a' rithist talla-bhaile. Dìreach mar thogalach sam bith eile tron là ach nuair a thuiteadh an oidhche agus a' thigeadh na brògan dannsa a-mach a bha mar saoghal eile. Documenting the place of village halls at the heart of communities across Scotland throughout the 20th century. The tearing down of old village halls across the Highlands and Islands marks the end of an era. Balivanich, Carinish, Acharacle, Lochmaddy, Leverburgh, Shawbost, Vatersay, Aird, Ness, the Highlanders' Institute - many halls have been replaced by buildings which focus their attention on the needs of a very different generation. The programme is illustrated with hilarious and often nostalgic anecdotes of these special places, so small and unimpressive by the light of day, but which were transformed by night into meccas of music and dance.

programme.title: Co-Sheirm
programme.desc: Sreath bhon tasglann a' taisbeanadh còisirean is guthan sònraichte. Anns a' phrògram seo, Còisir Ghàidhlig Shruighlea. Archive series with choirs and outstanding soloists, featuring The Stirling Gaelic Choir.

programme.title: Suas gu Deas
programme.desc: Tha’n fhèis chiùil Barralive a’ tilleadh a Bharraigh, tha Ruairidh agus Peter a’ faicinn seallaidhean annasach aig muir agus tha Joan a’ deisealachadh airson show Uibhist a Tuath. Much-loved music festival Barralive returns, while Ruairidh and Peter have an eventful trip to sea. Joan chooses her best lambs and cattle for the North Uist show. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Port Steòrnabhaigh
programme.desc: Based in the main port in the Hebrides, we follow the beating hearts of Stornoway Harbour. In her shelter, there is a bustling community to be found. In this episode, preparation works are full steam ahead at Stornoway’s new Deep Water Terminal, and we meet some American residents who take shelter in the harbour over the winter. Stèidhte ann am prìomh port nan Eilean Siar, the sinne a’ leantainn cridhe Port Steòrnabhaigh. Na fasgadh, tha coimhearsnachd trang ri lorg. Anns a’ phrògram seo, tha obair ullachaidh a’ dol aig a’ Chala Dhomhain ùr ann an Steòrnabhagh, ‘s coinnichidh sinn ri dithis Aimeireaganach a th’ ann an samhailteach a’ chala fad a’ gheamhraidh. Thig còmhla rinn ‘s sinn a’ leanntainn beatha ann am Port Steòrnabhaigh.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram ciùil air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Chaidh Seirm Celtic Connections a chlàradh ann an ionad Platform ann an Glaschu ann a 2022 le feadhainn den luchd-ciùil as fheàrr bho air feadh a RA, Eireann agus às an t-Suain. Anns a’ chiad prògram roghainneach seo gheibhear taghadh de cheòl dùthchasach agus traidiseanta bho Trail West, The Breath, Lena Jonsson Trio agus Brian Finnegan agus a chòmhlan. Trad and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Seirm Celtic Connections was filmed in Platform, Glasgow in 2022 with appearances from some of the best musicians from the UK, Ireland and Sweden. This first programme features a cross section of music from the world of trad and folk music including Trail West, The Breath, Lena Jonsson Trio and Brian Finnegan and band.

programme.title: Jimmy Johnstone
programme.desc: Deich bliadhna às dèidh a bhàs, tha 'Jimmy Johnstone' a' dèanamh luaidh air beatha fear dheth na sàr thàlantan ann an eachdraidh spòrs na h-Alba, ag innse soirbheas is doilgheas cluicheadair ball-coise sònraichte nach tèid à cuimhne gu bràth, laoch aig sgioba Celtic, cèile agus athair a chaill a bheatha air sàilleabh tinneas motor neurone aig aois 61. This programme examines the life of a phenomenal Scottish sporting talent Jimmy Johnstone, telling the story of the highs and the lows of an unforgettable working class footballer, Celtic legend, husband and father who lost his life to motor neurone disease age 61.

programme.title: Sgeulachd Cogaidh na h-Artaig/Untold Arctic Wars
programme.desc: Both the east and the west fail in their attempts to limit the threat posed by nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Seata cuirme le Sgoil Chiùil na Gàidhealtachd agus Hadhirgaan, clàraichte beò aig Duaisean nan Trads, 2025. A’ gabhail a-steach Fisherrow Set agus Netherbow Set. Concert set performed by Sgoil Chiùil na Gàidhealtachd and Hadhirgaan, recorded live at the Trad Awards, 2025. Featured tracks include Fisherrow Set and Netherbow Set.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tha Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air The Hoosiers len ceòl beothail indie pop air Àrd-Ùrlar a’ Ghàrraidh. Dh’fhàs an còmhlan ioma-phlatinum ainmeil ann an 2007 às dèidh a’ chiad chlàr aca agus òrain a leithid ‘Goodbye Mr A’ agus ‘Worried About Ray’, agus abair gun robh taisbeanadh dòigheil aca aig Belladrum 2025. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome The Hoosiers, who bring their infectious indie pop to the Garden Stage. The multi-platinum band rose to fame in 2007 after the release of their debut album and singalong hits Goodbye Mr A and Worried About Ray.

programme.title: This Is Joan Collins
programme.desc: A feature-length documentary on the life of one of the last surviving actresses from the golden age of Hollywood – Joan Collins. This epic film is told from the ringside as Joan narrates her rollercoaster life story with her inimitable wit and verve. A worldwide television phenomenon with her decade-defining role in Dynasty, Collins shares her extraordinary archive and never before seen home movie footage, giving an intimate glimpse into one of the world’s most iconic figures. Against a backdrop of Collins’s own narration, her story showcases the extraordinary life of a woman who has lived through the glitz, the glamour and the enduring moments of Hollywood history, and survived it all with panache.

programme.title: The Smuggling Business: Undercover
programme.desc: Over the past two years, tens of thousands of migrants have crossed the English Channel in small boats from northern France, despite repeated promises by successive governments to stop the trade. This undercover BBC investigation reveals how people smuggling gangs are operating in plain sight inside a migrant camp in Dunkirk. It exposes a highly organised criminal marketplace driven by fierce competition between rival groups, who enforce control over the settlements through fear, violence and intimidation. The film examines efforts by UK authorities to disrupt and dismantle the criminal networks profiting from the crossings, and questions whether those measures are keeping pace with the scale and sophistication of the operation. BBC investigative reporter Josie Hannett also travels to Crowborough, where opposition to a new asylum seeker accommodation site has turned the town into a flashpoint in the national immigration debate. She asks whether current government policy is likely to deter future arrivals, or whether the UK is preparing for a future that will require many more such sites across the south east

programme.title: Anna Haugh’s Big Irish Food Tour

programme.desc: It’s Jacob’s birthday, and everyone notices there’s something up with Zoe. She punishes Dan as she focuses on Solomon’s big career break. Dan’s romantic trip might offer hope, but it triggers deeply buried memories for Zoe. Did she choose this island for a reason? Jacob is trying to hide his age from Will, not helped by Will’s Gen Z mates gatecrashing their night out at a local taverna. When Jess goes on the attack to save her own skin, Zoe is left with nowhere to go but out.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents this high-stakes quiz, joined by a team of TV stars featuring Krishnan Guru-Murthy, Rev Kate Bottley, Cherry Healey and Babatunde Aleshe as they take on the Bridge of Lies for their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will half their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash for their chosen charities.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents this high-stakes quiz, joined by a team of TV stars featuring Krishnan Guru-Murthy, Rev Kate Bottley, Cherry Healey and Babatunde Aleshe as they take on the Bridge of Lies for their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will half their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash for their chosen charities.

programme.desc: Will and Dom learn how a devastating fire put a 5,000-year-old craft in jeopardy. Meanwhile, Chris Shaw repairs a Gaelic pipe music book, and Dom has the chance to make his own sporran.

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: A portrait of Julie Fleeting, who became Scotland’s all-time top scorer and an Arsenal legend while balancing life as a mum and PE teacher.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police are alerted to the discovery of human remains near Aviemore. They suspect this might be the last resting place of Rodrigo Falcon, a popular barman who went missing in December 2022. Sergeant Stephen Todd and his team confront a woman who is keeping monkeys and tropical animals in a ruined house in freezing cold Caithness. In Inverness, PC Siobhan Cooper faces rowdy bank holiday crowds.

programme.title: Only Child
programme.desc: Ken forces Richard to accompany him to Aviemore so that he can help him navigate the QR code scanner at the train station ticket barrier. However, a mix-up on the platform turns what should be a simple day trip into an almighty fiasco.

programme.title: Pitch Invasion: How the Scottish and Irish Changed Football
programme.desc: How managers and players such as David Moyes and Charlie Nicholas dealt with the highs and lows of English football.

programme.title: TRNSMT
programme.desc: Shereen Cutkelvin presents highlights from TRNSMT 2025, including performances from Wet Leg, James Bay, Jake Bugg, Fontaines DC, Jade, Biffy Clyro and Snow Patrol.

programme.title: This is BBC Scotland
programme.desc: Highlights from the BBC Scotland channel.

programme.title: Paranormal
programme.desc: Sian is frustrated that she still hasn’t been able to contact the Gower family who lived at the farmhouse – David, a former headmaster, his wife Rose-Mary and their son John-Paul. But there is a breakthrough of another kind when the current owner of Penyffordd Farm gets in touch and invites her over to see the house she’s heard so much about. Sian is welcomed in by Michael, who bought the house in Flintshire from the Gowers despite stories that it was haunted. He never believed their accounts, but he has heard rumours of the gravestone of a teenage girl called Jane Jones, which he suspects might still be on the property somewhere. The archive from Dr Daniels suggests that moving this gravestone was believed to be the precursor for all the strange happenings in the house, so it's the next lead for Sian to chase. Ghost or not, is there any historical evidence to suggest there really is a girl buried at Penyffordd Farm – and if so, why would she be buried in the garden? Sian tracks down a genealogist to see if there’s any truth to the story and finally gets an opportunity to speak to a member of the Gower family…

programme.title: Paranormal
programme.desc: Sian Eleri’s investigation into the haunting of Penyffordd Farm continues as multiple witnesses claim to have seen a hooded figure. Could they all have imagined the same thing?

programme.title: Paranormal
programme.desc: Sian's investigation into an allegedly haunted house in north Wales concludes. Can she track down the last family members and solve whether this was paranormal or all a hoax?

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Sports mockumentary about GB Paralympian Darren Silverstone, who stole the hearts of a nation before his infamous chokey-o in Tokyo. For the first time, he tells his story - and starts his glorious comeback. In Tokyo 2020, Darren Silverstone was the Paras GB poster boy. (He was on yoghurts, too.) He cruised to the final and charmed the nation along the way with his signature dance move, the dazzle. But as he took that final bend ready to take gold, Silverstone lost his head and celebrated too soon - and in the process, became a national figure of fun. His subsequent journey in the public eye brought approval and consternation in equal measure: from those unforgettably self-deprecating betting adverts to his turn on The Masked Singer as Breadbin. Darren’s best friend and pilot rider in Tokyo, little Paul Potter, was never seen again in the public eye. The two haven’t spoken since. And now, Silverstone’s back. Ready to take to the tandem at Paris 2024. But is he ready? Who will he be riding with? This is I Am Darren.

programme.title: Smoggie Queens
programme.desc: It’s that time of year again - the Mr Teesside Beauty Pageant, and the grand prize is £20,000, but someone foul is lurking in the shadows, attempting to fix the competition…

programme.title: Smoggie Queens
programme.desc: Dickie’s been booked for a drag gig and has invited a load of agents in the hope of making it to the big time, while Mam faces a ghost from her past.

programme.desc: Programmes start at 7.00pm

programme.desc: Programmes start at 7.00pm

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: In the near future, the Doctor and Clara find themselves on a space shuttle making a suicide mission to the moon. Crash-landing on the lunar surface, they find a mining base full of corpses, vicious spider-like creatures poised to attack, and a terrible dilemma. When Clara turns to the Doctor for help, she gets the shock of her life.

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: The Doctor and Clara are on the most beautiful train in history, speeding among the stars of the future. But a deadly creature is stalking the passengers. Once you see the horrifying mummy, you only have 66 seconds to live. No exceptions, no reprieve. As the Doctor races against the clock, Clara sees him at his deadliest and most ruthless. Will he work out how to defeat the mummy? Start the clock!

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Tilly's fiancee Rupert is on army leave and their wedding plans are in full swing. Miranda is set up with Rupert's ghastly best man Ping Pong Charlie at the same time as Stevie and Clive set her up with a 'special someone' else. Her date with the 'special someone' gives Miranda a new-found confidence that Ping Pong Charlie and Rupert find irresistible. How will she shake off Ping Pong Charlie? Should she tell Tilly about Rupert's advances, and more importantly, how long will the 'special someone' wait for a kiss?

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Miranda and Stevie compete to be best friends with the new waitress at the restaurant, Tamara. The trouble is that Tamara is 22, and they both find keeping up with an energetic 20-something surprisingly tiring. Their age becomes an issue after an art class, followed by all-night karaoke, followed by a swimming experience that puts Miranda face-to-face with her nudity issues. With Miranda and Stevie united, will they keep up with Tamara, or will they just bung their slippers on, get a hot chocolate and settle down in front of Midsomer Murders?

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: There's a storm blowing in Finglas, and it soon claims its first victim when the pipes burst in Winnie and Sharon's house. Thank goodness for Mrs Brown, who is on hand to offer a roof over their heads while repairs are carried out. It's not long before there's a storm brewing inside the Brown household too. Agnes and Cathy discover that living with best friends isn't the picnic they'd imagined. Agnes has yet more on her plate when she receives news of the death of a neighbour she never really knew - or even liked - and is asked by Father Damian to do her eulogy. And there is Bono's thirteenth birthday to host. It might all seem too much for Agnes, and then Buster drops a bombshell.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: There’s bad news for Winnie when Agnes discovers Peggy Piper the Pernod poisoner is out on appeal and could be coming back to Finglas. This could mean Winnie has to give evidence against her again as she was the one who saw Peggy poison her husband. Question is, is Peggy guilty or innocent? There's only one way of knowing for sure - and that's by meeting Peggy herself. Meanwhile, Buster loses the expensive tank costume Dermot’s hired for their latest promotion and must find it before it's too late. Sue Vincent guest stars.

programme.title: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret.
programme.desc: Eleven-year-old Margaret is uprooted from her life in New York City for the suburbs of New Jersey, going through the messy and tumultuous throes of puberty with new friends in a new school. She relies on her mother, Barbara, who is also struggling to adjust to life outside the big city, and her adoring grandmother, Sylvia, who isn’t happy they moved away and likes to remind them every chance she gets. Based on Judy Blume’s classic novel.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: The competition intensifies as the celebrity trio, EastEnders star Nitin Ganatra, the Rev Kate Bottley and Alex Gray, aka Apollo from Gladiators, return for day 2. Vernon Kay keeps order as the quiz master, while sidekick Paul Gorton takes the contestants on a tour of today’s destination, Dudley. The race to the weekly finale is well and truly on.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: On an ill-fated group boat trip, Zoe tries to pretend last night’s betrayal didn’t mean anything. But Dan’s behaviour threatens to push Zoe over the edge. Nat uses the kiss to drive a wedge between Jacob and his boyfriend Will, who has shown up uninvited. Solomon is the only one who doesn’t know what happened last night - does Zoe tell him and destroy two marriages? Jess is forced to take drastic action to avoid confrontation.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piripenguins face a few tricky problems, but they discover that swapping items and working together can provide clever solutions, turning a regular day into an extraordinary one.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: A strange rock far away from the ship breaks D.O.R.I.S.’s satnav. Luckily, Big Lizard’s on hand to teach Cosima how to find her way around without technology.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy promises to go camping with the ducklings, but he wants to watch football instead. During half-time, Weasy attempts to finish camping as quickly as possible.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Twinkle feels she is being taken for granted by the other heroes, so she joins the Fairy Squad when they arrive.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy struggles to pick coconuts, but the Lemmings find a magic conch.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: When Duck gets a job as a baker, Frog realises he can get free treats! However, a mix-up with the dough causes a birthday cake to grow out of control!

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons
programme.desc: Trainers put an intriguing new device into action at an Exceed testing centre.

programme.title: Bro's in Control
programme.desc: Adam and Joe become bus tour guides, except they must say and do as the other says. With Holly H and Radio 1’s Rickie joining as passengers, what could go wrong?

programme.title: Gladiators: Epic Pranks
programme.desc: Diamond, Cyclone, Nitro and Fire go head-to-head dishing out the dares in a restaurant. Will a robot, rock star, broccoli or water over the head cause a tap out?

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Blue Peter goes access all areas at Radio 1's Big Weekend with our lucky competition winner! Joel, Abby and Shini try DIY festival make-up looks, and The Adventures of Rap Kid by MC Grammar is the latest read in the Blue Peter Book Club.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With summer just around the corner, Monty is bringing bold colour to the garden, planting gingers and cannas, setting out tomatoes and sowing wallflowers straight into the soil. From her Devon garden, Carol Klein is exploring the latest plant science, uncovering what is really going on inside a seed the moment it is sown, and how this pioneering knowledge can transform the way people garden. Rekha Mistry is also on a mission to grow big in a small space, using only pots on her patio. In Oxfordshire, a garden designed for both beauty and biodiversity shows how plants can support wildlife as well as people. And a viewer in rural France shares a breathtaking, naturalistic plot that blends seamlessly with the surrounding landscape.

programme.title: Jailhouse Rock
programme.desc: Sentenced to jail for manslaughter, Vince Everett is taught to play the guitar by his cellmate - and a sensational new rock star is born.

programme.title: Rugby League Women's Challenge Cup
programme.desc: Wigan Warriors face St Helens in the final of the 2026 Women's Challenge Cup.

programme.title: Nicholas and Alexandra
programme.desc: Lavish, Oscar-winning account of the Russian royal family's demise in the days leading up to the 1917 revolution. When Tsar Nicholas weds the German princess Alexandra, the marriage proves unpopular with the Russian people, a situation not improved when she has four daughters. When she finally bears a son, the infant's acute haemophilia can only be controlled by the powers of the fanatical monk Rasputin.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: On a remote island in the Canadian Arctic, a pair of white gyrfalcons and a pack of Arctic wolves are both struggling to raise families during the short summer. As the falcons' eggs hatch, the race is on to catch enough young Arctic hares to feed them. The wolf pack are raising their cubs in a hillside den. The film records behaviour that has never been seen by scientists, let alone filmed. It is scored by the BBC's New TV Composers Scheme winner Anne Nikitin.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: At Ickworth House, an Italianate palace in the Suffolk countryside, Paul Martin is joined by experts Adam Partridge and Will Axon, who try to help members of the public make money out of their antiques by taking a risk at auction. Will is impressed by a chinoiserie travelling clock found at the back of a wardrobe, but it's a campaign writing box that raises the roof over at the auction - and keeps the crowds in the saleroom entertained! Paul also meets the people trying to safeguard the future of the Suffolk Punch horse, which holds a unique place in the history of the county after which it was named.

programme.title: Hidden Treasures of the National Trust
programme.desc: From a windswept island chapel battered by the North Sea to a quiet Welsh farmhouse that shaped the future of a language, this episode travels to two remote National Trust sites whose powerful stories have inspired centuries of pilgrims, revealing the delicate conservation work protecting their remarkable stories.

programme.title: Lucy Worsley Investigates
programme.desc: Lucy explores how the battle for American independence wasn’t only fought on American soil but also unfolded in Britain itself, with sabotage, espionage and political unrest reshaping the empire. She reflects on a revolution that created an independent America but which also reshaped Britain and its monarchy.

programme.title: Boxing
programme.desc: Live boxing as Adam Azim makes his return from injury against Steve Claggett.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: A look back at some of the songs performed on the show in 1993. Dance music and Euro pop continued to dominate the charts with performances from Haddaway, Sub Sub, Ace of Base and Robin S. The early stages of Britpop begin to emerge with Suede and Radiohead, and Icelandic superstar Björk makes an early appearance. Then there are the big sellers from Meat Loaf and Gabrielle, and the grooves come courtesy of Jamiroquai, Chaka Demus & Pliers and many more.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Revel in many of the biggest singles of 1994 as the TOTP archives are opened once more. Love ballads proved irresistible in 1994, with Wet Wet Wet’s 15-week stay at number one with Love Is All Around and East 17’s Christmas classic Stay Another Day conquering the charts. Britpop bubbled up with Elastica and Blur, blockbuster hits reigned once more with Elton John’s Lion King theme, and a young Ant and Dec rapped their way to the charts. Plus, quirky and catchy hits from Shampoo, Whigfield and The Grid, a final TOTP performance by Kate Bush, and many more! Featuring Blur, Corona, Tori Amos, PJ and Duncan (Ant and Dec), Sheryl Crow, East 17, Whigfield, The Cranberries, Dawn Penn, Elastica, Wet Wet Wet, Shampoo, Elton John, Pretenders, Kylie Minogue, Youssou N'Dour ft Neneh Cherry, The Grid, Kate Bush, Bon Jovi, Crash Test Dummies and D:Ream.

programme.title: Everything Went Fine
programme.desc: A daughter is forced to reconcile her past with her father when he contacts her with a devastating final wish, in François Ozon’s powerful family drama. André has never been the easiest of fathers, but when he suffers a debilitating stroke and calls on his daughter Emmanuèle to help him die with some dignity, she finds herself faced with a painful decision. An adaptation of Emmanuèle Bernheim’s memoir, Everything Went Fine is both a detailed portrait of family relationships and a frank account of the process involved in assisted dying. In French with English subtitles.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: A look back at some of the songs performed on the show in 1993. Dance music and Euro pop continued to dominate the charts with performances from Haddaway, Sub Sub, Ace of Base and Robin S. The early stages of Britpop begin to emerge with Suede and Radiohead, and Icelandic superstar Björk makes an early appearance. Then there are the big sellers from Meat Loaf and Gabrielle, and the grooves come courtesy of Jamiroquai, Chaka Demus & Pliers and many more.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Revel in many of the biggest singles of 1994 as the TOTP archives are opened once more. Love ballads proved irresistible in 1994, with Wet Wet Wet’s 15-week stay at number one with Love Is All Around and East 17’s Christmas classic Stay Another Day conquering the charts. Britpop bubbled up with Elastica and Blur, blockbuster hits reigned once more with Elton John’s Lion King theme, and a young Ant and Dec rapped their way to the charts. Plus, quirky and catchy hits from Shampoo, Whigfield and The Grid, a final TOTP performance by Kate Bush, and many more! Featuring Blur, Corona, Tori Amos, PJ and Duncan (Ant and Dec), Sheryl Crow, East 17, Whigfield, The Cranberries, Dawn Penn, Elastica, Wet Wet Wet, Shampoo, Elton John, Pretenders, Kylie Minogue, Youssou N'Dour ft Neneh Cherry, The Grid, Kate Bush, Bon Jovi, Crash Test Dummies and D:Ream.

programme.title: Everything Went Fine
programme.desc: A daughter is forced to reconcile her past with her father when he contacts her with a devastating final wish, in François Ozon’s powerful family drama. André has never been the easiest of fathers, but when he suffers a debilitating stroke and calls on his daughter Emmanuèle to help him die with some dignity, she finds herself faced with a painful decision. An adaptation of Emmanuèle Bernheim’s memoir, Everything Went Fine is both a detailed portrait of family relationships and a frank account of the process involved in assisted dying. In French with English subtitles.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Is that James Bond or weatherman Derek Brockway on the jet ski? On this stunning walk from Porth Neigwl to Abersoch on the Llyn peninsula, Derek samples the jet set life and local honey, which he describes as ‘blasus Iawn’ – delicious! He’s not the only one brushing up on his Welsh. Comedian Kiri Pritchard-McLean goes back to school at Nant Gwyrtheyrn, while Mo Jannah explores the mystery of an African longboat in a Welsh museum.

programme.title: Springwatch in Wales
programme.desc: Iolo Williams recounts the best Springwatch stories exploring woodlands. Iolo’s journey begins in the ancient Celtic rainforest where a whole cast of species depend on our mature oaks. Gillian Burke ventures to Anglesey island, where she discovers how the UK’s beloved red squirrel made a comeback to Wales. Iolo shares secrets of the woodland floor, from miniature insect dramas to delightful carpets of bluebells. Night reveals a glimpse into the hidden lives of tawny owls as they navigate tangled trees in search of food. Gillian shares the reintroduction of one of the most exciting additions to Welsh woodlands – the pine marten.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With summer just around the corner, Monty is bringing bold colour to the garden, planting gingers and cannas, setting out tomatoes and sowing wallflowers straight into the soil. From her Devon garden, Carol Klein is exploring the latest plant science, uncovering what is really going on inside a seed the moment it is sown, and how this pioneering knowledge can transform the way people garden. Rekha Mistry is also on a mission to grow big in a small space, using only pots on her patio. In Oxfordshire, a garden designed for both beauty and biodiversity shows how plants can support wildlife as well as people. And a viewer in rural France shares a breathtaking, naturalistic plot that blends seamlessly with the surrounding landscape.

programme.title: Jailhouse Rock
programme.desc: Sentenced to jail for manslaughter, Vince Everett is taught to play the guitar by his cellmate - and a sensational new rock star is born.

programme.title: Rugby League Women's Challenge Cup
programme.desc: Wigan Warriors face St Helens in the final of the 2026 Women's Challenge Cup.

programme.title: Nicholas and Alexandra
programme.desc: Lavish, Oscar-winning account of the Russian royal family's demise in the days leading up to the 1917 revolution. When Tsar Nicholas weds the German princess Alexandra, the marriage proves unpopular with the Russian people, a situation not improved when she has four daughters. When she finally bears a son, the infant's acute haemophilia can only be controlled by the powers of the fanatical monk Rasputin.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: On a remote island in the Canadian Arctic, a pair of white gyrfalcons and a pack of Arctic wolves are both struggling to raise families during the short summer. As the falcons' eggs hatch, the race is on to catch enough young Arctic hares to feed them. The wolf pack are raising their cubs in a hillside den. The film records behaviour that has never been seen by scientists, let alone filmed. It is scored by the BBC's New TV Composers Scheme winner Anne Nikitin.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: At Ickworth House, an Italianate palace in the Suffolk countryside, Paul Martin is joined by experts Adam Partridge and Will Axon, who try to help members of the public make money out of their antiques by taking a risk at auction. Will is impressed by a chinoiserie travelling clock found at the back of a wardrobe, but it's a campaign writing box that raises the roof over at the auction - and keeps the crowds in the saleroom entertained! Paul also meets the people trying to safeguard the future of the Suffolk Punch horse, which holds a unique place in the history of the county after which it was named.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Is that James Bond or weatherman Derek Brockway on the jet ski? On this stunning walk from Porth Neigwl to Abersoch on the Llyn peninsula, Derek samples the jet set life and local honey, which he describes as ‘blasus Iawn’ – delicious! He’s not the only one brushing up on his Welsh. Comedian Kiri Pritchard-McLean goes back to school at Nant Gwyrtheyrn, while Mo Jannah explores the mystery of an African longboat in a Welsh museum.

programme.title: Springwatch in Wales
programme.desc: Iolo Williams recounts the best Springwatch stories exploring woodlands. Iolo’s journey begins in the ancient Celtic rainforest where a whole cast of species depend on our mature oaks. Gillian Burke ventures to Anglesey island, where she discovers how the UK’s beloved red squirrel made a comeback to Wales. Iolo shares secrets of the woodland floor, from miniature insect dramas to delightful carpets of bluebells. Night reveals a glimpse into the hidden lives of tawny owls as they navigate tangled trees in search of food. Gillian shares the reintroduction of one of the most exciting additions to Welsh woodlands – the pine marten.

programme.title: Lucy Worsley Investigates
programme.desc: Lucy explores how the battle for American independence wasn’t only fought on American soil but also unfolded in Britain itself, with sabotage, espionage and political unrest reshaping the empire. She reflects on a revolution that created an independent America but which also reshaped Britain and its monarchy.

programme.title: Boxing
programme.desc: Live boxing as Adam Azim makes his return from injury against Steve Claggett.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: A look back at some of the songs performed on the show in 1993. Dance music and Euro pop continued to dominate the charts with performances from Haddaway, Sub Sub, Ace of Base and Robin S. The early stages of Britpop begin to emerge with Suede and Radiohead, and Icelandic superstar Björk makes an early appearance. Then there are the big sellers from Meat Loaf and Gabrielle, and the grooves come courtesy of Jamiroquai, Chaka Demus & Pliers and many more.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Revel in many of the biggest singles of 1994 as the TOTP archives are opened once more. Love ballads proved irresistible in 1994, with Wet Wet Wet’s 15-week stay at number one with Love Is All Around and East 17’s Christmas classic Stay Another Day conquering the charts. Britpop bubbled up with Elastica and Blur, blockbuster hits reigned once more with Elton John’s Lion King theme, and a young Ant and Dec rapped their way to the charts. Plus, quirky and catchy hits from Shampoo, Whigfield and The Grid, a final TOTP performance by Kate Bush, and many more! Featuring Blur, Corona, Tori Amos, PJ and Duncan (Ant and Dec), Sheryl Crow, East 17, Whigfield, The Cranberries, Dawn Penn, Elastica, Wet Wet Wet, Shampoo, Elton John, Pretenders, Kylie Minogue, Youssou N'Dour ft Neneh Cherry, The Grid, Kate Bush, Bon Jovi, Crash Test Dummies and D:Ream.

programme.title: Everything Went Fine
programme.desc: A daughter is forced to reconcile her past with her father when he contacts her with a devastating final wish, in François Ozon’s powerful family drama. André has never been the easiest of fathers, but when he suffers a debilitating stroke and calls on his daughter Emmanuèle to help him die with some dignity, she finds herself faced with a painful decision. An adaptation of Emmanuèle Bernheim’s memoir, Everything Went Fine is both a detailed portrait of family relationships and a frank account of the process involved in assisted dying. In French with English subtitles.

But poor old Happy just cannot get it right - until he comes up with a great idea, one that will make the biggest bubble ever! Just watch out for prickly old Hedgely!

programme.title: Octonauts

programme.title: Vida the Vet

programme.title: Go Jetters

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Ruby and Finn’s seeds have started to grow, but Rafi’s cherry seed shows no change. Feeling left out, she makes a wish, and a giant cherry tree appears! It’s exciting at first, but when the wish ends, everything disappears. Rafi feels sad, until Doris shares a story about planting an apple tree when she was little. Rafi realises that nature likes to take its time and waiting can bring something special.

programme.title: Yukee

programme.title: Froglets

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends visit a planetarium where they learn all about outer space. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble tries to spot a shooting star using his new telescope.

programme.title: The Toddler Club
programme.desc: Gemma, Benjee Bear and Bailee Bear welcome toddlers Betsy, Joshua, Maisy, Layla and Arabella, and their grown-ups, to the Toddler Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! The What’s in the Box? game reveals a happy face and a sad face, and when the toddlers and parents open up a bigger box, they discover lots more objects and toys that are inspired by feelings. This theme is explored through play, song and story. Grown-ups are encouraged to take part at home by hiding a safe, toddler-appropriate feelings toy or object inside a recycled box for them to reveal and explore with their toddler! Storytime is all about discovering new words, as Benjee Bear and Bailee Bear have a party and invite their friends. But what feelings will they have once everyone arrives and the party starts? Viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring the feelings theme too. And, The Circle Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with stretching and the Goodbye song.

programme.title: Vegesaurs

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava love pretending and make-believe. In this episode, they enjoy a pretend picnic in their bedroom and invent amazing recipes like strawberry stew and vegetable cake! They’re so yummy that Mum gets the hiccups. Later, Eden and Ava build a den for the whole family to hide in. They imagine they’re camping in the woods and look out at the stars. But will they be safe from the noisy tiger in the forest? Roar!

Finally, the Squirrels express their love of animals with an epic new song.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand, Dermot rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making. Guided by Clare from Mussenden Salt, he learns the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Embracing ancient Irish traditions, they host a clan-style cookout, roasting meat, cheese, and vegetables over open flames as previous generations once did. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot joins local lobster fisherman Peter, heading out onto the water to haul in pots. With fresh lobster secured, Dermot visits LIR Seafood Restaurant, where husband-and-wife team Rebekah and Stevie champion a zero-waste approach to cooking. In the kitchen, Dermot gets hands-on, learning to prepare indulgent lobster rolls while discovering how thoughtful cooking can turn every part of the catch into something delicious.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: Cult adventure comedy. The community of the peaceful coastal town of Goon Docks, Oregon faces imminent foreclosure to make way for a golf course when a band of local childhood friends calling themselves the Goonies stumble upon an old map - the map provides secret clues leading to the fabled treasure of a notorious pirate known as One-Eyed Willy and sets in motion a wild mission to save their homes. With the criminal Fratelli family hot on their trail, a frantic race against time begins...

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Arriving in Derry at the end of the Causeway Coastal Route, Dermot finds a city rewriting its story, with the River Foyle as its beating heart. At the Walled City Brewery - once Army Barracks during the Troubles - he uncovers a secret local ingredient behind their standout brews. For a fresh perspective, Dermot hits the water with kayak instructor Michelle, paddling the Foyle and taking in the skyline from a whole new angle - equal parts scenic and splashy. Back on land, things get fiery on a double-decker bus-turned-taco joint. At Pyke 'N' Pommes, local legend Kevin Pyke blends bold Mexican flavours with top-notch Irish seafood. Dermot gets hands-on, prepping calamari and building tasty tacos that capture Derry's evolving food scene.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left, and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned. Whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage, are Harry’s days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand, Dermot rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making. Guided by Clare from Mussenden Salt, he learns the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Embracing ancient Irish traditions, they host a clan-style cookout, roasting meat, cheese, and vegetables over open flames as previous generations once did. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot joins local lobster fisherman Peter, heading out onto the water to haul in pots. With fresh lobster secured, Dermot visits LIR Seafood Restaurant, where husband-and-wife team Rebekah and Stevie champion a zero-waste approach to cooking. In the kitchen, Dermot gets hands-on, learning to prepare indulgent lobster rolls while discovering how thoughtful cooking can turn every part of the catch into something delicious.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Arriving in Derry at the end of the Causeway Coastal Route, Dermot finds a city rewriting its story, with the River Foyle as its beating heart. At the Walled City Brewery - once Army Barracks during the Troubles - he uncovers a secret local ingredient behind their standout brews. For a fresh perspective, Dermot hits the water with kayak instructor Michelle, paddling the Foyle and taking in the skyline from a whole new angle - equal parts scenic and splashy. Back on land, things get fiery on a double-decker bus-turned-taco joint. At Pyke 'N' Pommes, local legend Kevin Pyke blends bold Mexican flavours with top-notch Irish seafood. Dermot gets hands-on, prepping calamari and building tasty tacos that capture Derry's evolving food scene.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Arriving in Derry at the end of the Causeway Coastal Route, Dermot finds a city rewriting its story, with the River Foyle as its beating heart. At the Walled City Brewery - once Army Barracks during the Troubles - he uncovers a secret local ingredient behind their standout brews. For a fresh perspective, Dermot hits the water with kayak instructor Michelle, paddling the Foyle and taking in the skyline from a whole new angle - equal parts scenic and splashy. Back on land, things get fiery on a double-decker bus-turned-taco joint. At Pyke 'N' Pommes, local legend Kevin Pyke blends bold Mexican flavours with top-notch Irish seafood. Dermot gets hands-on, prepping calamari and building tasty tacos that capture Derry's evolving food scene.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left, and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned. Whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage, are Harry’s days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Fast-moving action thriller. Kim is the pride and joy of her father Bryan Mills, who left the Central Intelligence Agency to be near her in California. Kim manages to convince her father to allow her to travel to Paris with her friend Amanda, but when the girls arrive in Paris, they share a cab with a stranger and let slip that they are alone there. A gang of human traffickers kidnaps the girls using this information, but not before Bryan learns of this and issues a chilling threat to the gang.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand, Dermot rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making. Guided by Clare from Mussenden Salt, he learns the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Embracing ancient Irish traditions, they host a clan-style cookout, roasting meat, cheese, and vegetables over open flames as previous generations once did. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot joins local lobster fisherman Peter, heading out onto the water to haul in pots. With fresh lobster secured, Dermot visits LIR Seafood Restaurant, where husband-and-wife team Rebekah and Stevie champion a zero-waste approach to cooking. In the kitchen, Dermot gets hands-on, learning to prepare indulgent lobster rolls while discovering how thoughtful cooking can turn every part of the catch into something delicious.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: Cult adventure comedy. The community of the peaceful coastal town of Goon Docks, Oregon faces imminent foreclosure to make way for a golf course when a band of local childhood friends calling themselves the Goonies stumble upon an old map - the map provides secret clues leading to the fabled treasure of a notorious pirate known as One-Eyed Willy and sets in motion a wild mission to save their homes. With the criminal Fratelli family hot on their trail, a frantic race against time begins...

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: Emily Atack and Danny Dyer host a strategic reality quiz packed full of drama and deception. With fewer players left, and the finale looming, alliances tighten and betrayals feel inevitable. Harry reveals himself to be great at maths and this has not gone unnoticed. The game has now turned. Whispered conversations, overheard plots and shifting loyalties dominate the house as players begin thinking not about survival, but about who they want to face in the final. A maths challenge rewards bold, decisive play from Billy and delivers a powerful advantage, are Harry’s days numbered? With trust diminishing by the hour, does Kamaal succumb to group pressure or does he turn on one of the co-conspirators? Regardless, playing nicely is no longer an option.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Fast-moving action thriller. Kim is the pride and joy of her father Bryan Mills, who left the Central Intelligence Agency to be near her in California. Kim manages to convince her father to allow her to travel to Paris with her friend Amanda, but when the girls arrive in Paris, they share a cab with a stranger and let slip that they are alone there. programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand, Dermot rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making. Guided by Clare from Mussenden Salt, he learns the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Embracing ancient Irish traditions, they host a clan-style cookout, roasting meat, cheese, and vegetables over open flames as previous generations once did. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot joins local lobster fisherman Peter, heading out onto the water to haul in pots. With fresh lobster secured, Dermot visits LIR Seafood Restaurant, where husband-and-wife team Rebekah and Stevie champion a zero-waste approach to cooking. In the kitchen, Dermot gets hands-on, learning to prepare indulgent lobster rolls while discovering how thoughtful cooking can turn every part of the catch into something delicious.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand, Dermot rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making. Guided by Clare from Mussenden Salt, he learns the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Embracing ancient Irish traditions, they host a clan-style cookout, roasting meat, cheese, and vegetables over open flames as previous generations once did. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot joins local lobster fisherman Peter, heading out onto the water to haul in pots. With fresh lobster secured, Dermot visits LIR Seafood Restaurant, where husband-and-wife team Rebekah and Stevie champion a zero-waste approach to cooking. In the kitchen, Dermot gets hands-on, learning to prepare indulgent lobster rolls while discovering how thoughtful cooking can turn every part of the catch into something delicious.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: Cult adventure comedy. The community of the peaceful coastal town of Goon Docks, Oregon faces imminent foreclosure to make way for a golf course when a band of local childhood friends calling themselves the Goonies stumble upon an old map - the map provides secret clues leading to the fabled treasure of a notorious pirate known as One-Eyed Willy and sets in motion a wild mission to save their homes. With the criminal Fratelli family hot on their trail, a frantic race against time begins...

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Arriving in Derry at the end of the Causeway Coastal Route, Dermot finds a city rewriting its story, with the River Foyle as its beating heart. At the Walled City Brewery - once Army Barracks during the Troubles - he uncovers a secret local ingredient behind their standout brews. For a fresh perspective, Dermot hits the water with kayak instructor Michelle, paddling the Foyle and taking in the skyline from a whole new angle - equal parts scenic and splashy. Back on land, things get fiery on a double-decker bus-turned-taco joint. At Pyke 'N' Pommes, local legend Kevin Pyke blends bold Mexican flavours with top-notch Irish seafood. Dermot gets hands-on, prepping calamari and building tasty tacos that capture Derry's evolving food scene.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand, Dermot rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making. Guided by Clare from Mussenden Salt, he learns the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Embracing ancient Irish traditions, they host a clan-style cookout, roasting meat, cheese, and vegetables over open flames as previous generations once did. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot joins local lobster fisherman Peter, heading out onto the water to haul in pots. With fresh lobster secured, Dermot visits LIR Seafood Restaurant, where husband-and-wife team Rebekah and Stevie champion a zero-waste approach to cooking. In the kitchen, Dermot gets hands-on, learning to prepare indulgent lobster rolls while discovering how thoughtful cooking can turn every part of the catch into something delicious.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: Cult adventure comedy. The community of the peaceful coastal town of Goon Docks, Oregon faces imminent foreclosure to make way for a golf course when a band of local childhood friends calling themselves the Goonies stumble upon an old map - the map provides secret clues leading to the fabled treasure of a notorious pirate known as One-Eyed Willy and sets in motion a wild mission to save their homes. With the criminal Fratelli family hot on their trail, a frantic race against time begins...

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Arriving in Derry at the end of the Causeway Coastal Route, Dermot finds a city rewriting its story, with the River Foyle as its beating heart. At the Walled City Brewery - once Army Barracks during the Troubles - he uncovers a secret local ingredient behind their standout brews. For a fresh perspective, Dermot hits the water with kayak instructor Michelle, paddling the Foyle and taking in the skyline from a whole new angle - equal parts scenic and splashy. Back on land, things get fiery on a double-decker bus-turned-taco joint. At Pyke 'N' Pommes, local legend Kevin Pyke blends bold Mexican flavours with top-notch Irish seafood. Dermot gets hands-on, prepping calamari and building tasty tacos that capture Derry's evolving food scene.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal Celebrity Special

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand, Dermot rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making. Guided by Clare from Mussenden Salt, he learns the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Embracing ancient Irish traditions, they host a clan-style cookout, roasting meat, cheese, and vegetables over open flames as previous generations once did. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot joins local lobster fisherman Peter, heading out onto the water to haul in pots. With fresh lobster secured, Dermot visits LIR Seafood Restaurant, where husband-and-wife team Rebekah and Stevie champion a zero-waste approach to cooking. In the kitchen, Dermot gets hands-on, learning to prepare indulgent lobster rolls while discovering how thoughtful cooking can turn every part of the catch into something delicious.
